# AI Contribution Policy

This policy explains how AI-generated and AI-assisted contributions are handled across repositories owned by the [Guchho](https://github.com/guchho) organization.

## Our stance

AI tools can be useful for drafting, exploring, and learning. We accept contributions that involve AI assistance, provided the human contributor takes full ownership of the submitted work.

## Rules for contributors

1. **You are accountable for what you submit.** By opening a pull request or issue, you affirm that you have reviewed, tested, and understood every part of the contribution — including anything produced with the help of AI tools.

2. **Disclose substantial AI use.** If AI tools generated a significant portion of the code, documentation, or tests in your contribution, mention it in the pull request description (e.g., "Drafted with assistance from GitHub Copilot" or "Reviewed with an AI assistant"). Minor autocomplete suggestions do not need disclosure.

3. **No purely AI-generated contributions.** Pull requests that consist mainly of unreviewed AI output will be closed. Contributions must reflect genuine human intent, judgment, and understanding of the project.

4. **Verify before submitting.** AI tools can produce plausible-looking but incorrect or insecure code. You are responsible for:
   - Confirming the code compiles/builds and passes tests.
   - Checking for security vulnerabilities.
   - Ensuring the contribution does not infringe on third-party licenses or rights.

5. **Respect licensing and copyright.** Do not submit AI-generated content that reproduces substantial portions of copyrighted material or code under incompatible licenses.

6. **Respect privacy.** Do not paste confidential, proprietary, or personally identifiable information into AI tools as part of preparing a contribution.

## Maintainer discretion

Maintainers may request clarification about how a contribution was produced, ask for additional justification or tests, or decline contributions that appear to be low-quality AI output. Maintainers may update or amend this policy at any time.

## AI use by maintainers

Maintainers may use AI tools to triage issues, review code, draft documentation, and maintain the project. AI usage by maintainers does not change the standards applied to community contributions.

## Questions

If you have questions about this policy, open a discussion or issue in the relevant repository.
